name: Feedback
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Record feedback about anything on your Omarchy desktop: a plugin, an app, a window, or Omarchy itself. A small always-on event log (window focus and shortcuts, never typed text; paused while locked) and an optional screen replay show what led up to the issue. Press the bug to capture a screenshot you can mark up, file it in a local issue list, and send it to Rix, your coding agent, or the author. A local web viewer replays the lead-up and exports PDF or Markdown.
